answer: To deter Sybil attacks, an agent economy can authenticate hardware clock-skew derived from a physical quartz crystal resonator. Each node uses its secure enclave as an unforgeable quill to sign microsecond challenge responses. An adversary incurs the verifiable hardware expense of provisioning distinct physical chips rather than virtualizing identities on one host. However, ambient temperature swings can destabilize crystal frequency, erroneously disqualifying legitimate agents.
